name: Jellyfin Federation
description: Aggregate content from multiple Jellyfin servers into unified virtual libraries
overview: The Jellyfin Federation Plugin allows you to create a unified media library by aggregating content from multiple remote Jellyfin servers. Stream content from any server without file synchronization.
changelog: Unreachable friends' titles now hide and return: the availability pinger and the hide/restore path share one service instance, so Plex-only (or any single-server) items leave the library while that friend is down and are recreated from cache when it answers again. Server-to-server downloads survive a restart: partial files resume via HTTP Range, pause when the source is unreachable, and keep showing size and speed. Plex posters are copied into Jellyfin's local image store by native id even when the catalog snapshot has no thumb tag.
